title: Wernher von Braun's Project Mars and a leader called 'Elon'

tellings.quote: in 1952 former Nazi and father of the American Space Program wner Von braa published a science fiction book titled project Mars a technical Tale in this novel he predicted a future mission to colonize Mars led by a figure referred to as Elon

plain: In 1952 the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, a former Nazi whom Michels calls the father of the American space program, published a science fiction novel called Project Mars: A Technical Tale. In it, Michels says, a future mission to colonise Mars is led by a figure called "Elon". Michels brings it up himself in an episode about the idea that the mind can sense the future, as a possible case of a writer glimpsing what was to come.
